gameDescriptionHtml: Start your journey in GOD EATER Resurrection as a new member of the GOD EATER elit squad. Your mission is to defeat the Aragami and gather material from them for research, but you come to realize that you are being drawn in to a giant conspiracy that will irreversibly alter the fate of humanity. Three years after the events of GOD EATER Resurrection, a mysterious red rain sparks a fatal pandemic called the Black Plague. Members of the Special Unit “Blood”, an affiliate of the Fenrir Organization, are sent to investigate…
